evidence_workers.scope: Independently review the implementation diff and resulting workspace against the ratified plan: acceptance-criteria coverage, test quality and honesty (weakened, deleted, gamed, or narrowed tests), scope control, maintainability, and security. Read code; do not execute the test plan — the parallel QA worker owns execution.

Execute the ratified test plan against the resulting workspace. Run every case, record reproducible evidence (commands, observations, paths) per case, and state a result for each acceptance criterion the plan maps. Do not re-execute a deterministic repository profile a harness gate or baseline already passed for this workspace — cite that gate evidence instead; the harness reruns the authoritative profile at submission. Do not review code style or architecture — the parallel review worker owns that.

criteria.statement: Every acceptance criterion is independently verified against the resulting workspace.
Tests are meaningful, correctly scoped, resistant to false positives, and were not weakened to pass.
QA cases from the ratified test plan cover each acceptance criterion or explicitly justify why a case is not applicable.
The verification suite selected by the run's verification level passes.
